question: A wire of length $2\text{ m}$ and area of cross-section $4 \times 10^{-7}\text{ m}^2$ has resistance $5\Omega$. Calculate its resistivity and state whether it is more likely to be a good conductor or a poor conductor.

options.A: $\rho=1.0\times10^{-8}\,\Omega\text{ m}$; it is an excellent metallic conductor like copper
options.B: $\rho=1.0\times10^{-6}\,\Omega\text{ m}$; it is a conductor, but poorer than very low-resistivity metals
